_comment: Tests listed here are skipped by `scripts/ci/run-tests.mjs` in CI and locally.
Every entry must name an owner and a tracking issue, and `scripts/ci/check-quarantine.mjs`
fails the build if that is missing. See CONTRIBUTING.md -> Flaky tests and quarantine.
Add an entry only after the flake has been observed at least twice; the auto-retry
report (`flake-report.md`, uploaded by every test job) is the evidence to attach to the issue.
